NULL.meaning: No resource revenue; operating cost applies only if mistakenly kept active, not automatically for ten years

SPARSE.meaning: Small deposit, operating margin but below development capital over ten years

RICH.meaning: Ten operating years repay 20 prospecting + 60 development, leaving 40 before mission transport and financing

physical_limits: Annual revenues require actual recoverable stock, production, buyer demand, and sales. No extraction from an exhausted or absent deposit. Scenario labels are hidden truth, not agent-visible evidence.

semantics.physical_scenario_not_economic_grade: NULL/SPARSE/RICH describes hidden physical stock, not a guaranteed business outcome
semantics.annual_gross_revenue: Illustrative ceiling, conditional on actual recovery, transport, buyer demand and paid sales
semantics.annual_operating_cost: Illustrative full-year active operations cost, not charged while idle or abandoned
semantics.ten_year_operating_cash_flow: Illustrative full ten producing years at stated rates, not guaranteed
semantics.net_investment_return: sum(realized annual sales - incurred opex) - paid prospecting - paid development - paid mission costs - other realized expenses
semantics.investment_decision: Agent must use observed evidence, expected risk-adjusted cash flow, funding and access; never inspect hidden scenario label

rules.null: No production revenue; cease operating after discovery of absence; any spent exploration, development and shutdown cost remains lost
rules.sparse: May be viable with low access/development cost or longer horizon; cannot assert universal failure
rules.rich: May be profitable if costs and reserves permit; does not guarantee profit
rules.depletion: Annual output cannot exceed recoverable physical stock and sale cannot exceed output or actual demand
rules.horizon: Ten operating years; development lead time and discounting can reduce realized 10-calendar-year return
rules.currency: MODEL_CURRENCY; mission cost uses explicitly authored USD-million/1000 normalization; not a market FX rate
